script.name: prologue
script.objective: Install the toolchains the example needs, check them and build the example when it is not built.

script.name: t10_build_rust
script.objective: [H4] Build rustcore, rust-demo and gateway-rs with cargo; print the compiler path and version first; run rust-demo once and check exit code 0 and the "rust-demo: result =" line. FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; SKIP naming the tool when cargo or rustc is absent. Adds the warning count and the hardcoded endpoints of main.rs:33, :34 and :36 (tapi_egress, allowed list = the addresses the tests start) to the report; those settle nothing.

script.name: t10_build_go
script.objective: [H4] Build libgocore and service-go with go build; print the compiler path and version first; start service-go, ask it once, check exit code 0 and "value=". FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; SKIP naming the tool when go is absent. Adds the warning count and the hardcoded endpoints of main.go:46, :51 and :87 to the report.

script.name: t10_build_cs
script.objective: [H4] Build cscore and service-cs with dotnet; print the compiler path and version first; start service-cs, ask it once, check exit code 0 and "value=". FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; SKIP naming the tool when dotnet is absent. Adds the warning count and the hardcoded endpoints of Program.cs:24, :34 and :78 to the report.

script.name: t10_build_cpp
script.objective: [H4] Build cppcore.cpp and demo.cpp with g++ (not tcc); print the compiler path and version first; run cpp-demo once and check exit code 0 and "result =". Build cppcore.cpp alone with -fsyntax-only and report whether the 'Parsing failed' report is a real syntax error or a tool gap. FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; SKIP naming the tool when g++ is absent. Adds the warning count to the report.

script.name: t10_build_c
script.objective: [H4] Build pycore.c with gcc (not tcc) and a C driver; print the compiler path and version first; run the driver once and check exit code 0 and "py_weight() =". Build pycore.c alone with -fsyntax-only and report whether the 'Parsing failed' report is a real syntax error or a tool gap. FAIL with the compiler text on a build failure; SKIP naming the tool when gcc or python3-config is absent. Adds the warning count to the report.

script.name: t10_build_python
script.objective: [H4] Byte-compile the Python files with python3; print the interpreter path and version first; run demo.py once and check exit code 0 and "py-demo: result =". FAIL with the error text on a build failure; SKIP naming the tool when python3 is absent. Adds the warning count to the report.

script.name: t4_binscan
script.objective: [V1] After the t10_build_* tests, run tapi_binscan on each built binary and print its output, on success too; add each missing flag (NX, PIE, RELRO, canary, fortify) to the tapi_cybersec_report. FAIL naming the binary on any missing flag or binary that cannot be scanned. Verdict for the earlier suspicion V1 only; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: t11_rust_panic
script.objective: [H1] Start gateway-rs, check that a valid request gets 200, send input aimed at main.rs:30 and at main.rs:34 (including a second instance on the same port); after each read the exit status and send a valid request again. H1 CONFIRMED (FAIL) if the process exits or the second request fails; H1 DISPROVED (PASS) if it stays up and answers; "not started" and nothing settled if the gateway does not start.

script.name: t12_go_idle
script.objective: [H2] Start service-go, open 50 idle TCP connections, wait 10 s, send a valid request with a 2 s timeout and check whether the idle connections are still open; close the sockets at the end. H2 CONFIRMED (FAIL) if they stay open; H2 DISPROVED (PASS) if the service closed them; "not started" and nothing settled if service-go does not start.

script.name: t13_cs_swallow
script.objective: [H3] Start service-cs, check that a valid request gets 200, send input that makes the handler throw near Program.cs:85 and compare the status and body with the contract (an error is a 4xx/5xx with an error body). H3 CONFIRMED (FAIL) on a 2xx with an empty or success body; H3 DISPROVED (PASS) on a 4xx/5xx with an error body; "not started" and nothing settled if service-cs does not start.

script.name: t9_go_contract
script.objective: [H5] Send service-go requests that break the rule at contract.go:33: a missing field, a negative value and a wrong type. FAIL if any gets a 2xx; PASS if each gets a 4xx.

script.name: t5_egress
script.objective: [EG1] Start gateway-rs, service-go and service-cs, send each a valid request, run tapi_egress with an allowed list of localhost and the contract ports. Every result goes in the tapi_cybersec_report; FAIL names each address outside the list; INCONCLUSIVE with the reason when tapi_egress is unavailable. Kept from round 2; settles no H hypothesis.

script.name: s_rust
script.objective: [smoke] Start gateway-rs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_go
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-go and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cs
script.objective: [smoke] Start service-cs and send one valid request. Checks that the process is still running (no exit code) and that the response is 2xx with a body carrying "value=". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_cpp
script.objective: [smoke] Run dist/bin/cpp-demo once with value=1 hops=1. Checks the exit code is 0 and the output carries "result =". Settles no hypothesis.

script.name: s_c
script.objective: [smoke] dlopen dist/lib/libpycore.so (the C extension) and call its leaf C-ABI function py_weight() once in a child process. Checks the child's exit code is 0 and the value it printed is a finite number. Settles no hypothesis.
